workarounds.note: the engine does not warn about unknown :ref ids or uncited figures, so the pen lists the mentions with parseMarkdown, diffs the ids itself and throws before building
config.locale does not localise Figure: resourceTypes: defaultResourceTypes(LANG) is passed by hand
the H1 breakBefore is restated because a headings object drops it

a float is queued when its citing paragraph starts, not at the :ref line, so the lakes paragraph cites Figure 2.7 in its first sentence and starts on the chapter's last page, which keeps the figure below its citation (gotcha float-queues-at-paragraph)

an inline (position 'here') figure gets one grid line of space above it (build.ts spacingBefore = max(pendingSpacing, floatGapPx)) but below it only the grid-snap remainder, so the text after it can start right under the credit note; the Markdown follows ::resource{id="roche"} with :::space{lines=1} (gotcha here-figure-no-space-after)

col() writes the palette hex beside each paletteId and bodyText.referenceColor is restated: 1.4.1 paints the opener, running-head and drop-folio colours and referenceColor from the inline hex, never from the palette (gotcha palette-skips-designs)
locale is the exact bundled code ('en-us' | 'es'): a region-tagged code such as 'es-ES' silently hyphenates as American English (gotcha hyphenation-locales)
